known_open: Event wiring is verified by compilation and unit behavior, not a running Paper/Folia server or actual client.
Actorless spawn/explosion: NONE denies and every other rank allows; player-attributed actions retain rank checks and owner/admin/temporary overrides.
Unattributed hopper/piston/flow/fire movements cannot cross a parent or child boundary even for the same owner; there is no implicit shared-owner exception.
Folia remote player-attributed projectiles are denied synchronously because permissions cannot be read from another region thread.
Environmental growth, falling blocks, dispenser variants and other indirect mutation families need additional coverage; this is not a complete all-vanilla-events proof.
Full live biome rendering and version-specific event registration/movement behavior require deferred server acceptance.
A concurrent authority update after the final check is not serialized with later vanilla world changes; cross-process cache consistency is also not implemented.
Temporary grants remain in memory and are invalidated by any parent or child generation change, including child retirement.
Explicit first source selection, external old-writer shutdown, portable relocation and wrong pending selection recovery remain operational responsibilities.
Cuboid/foundation treaty and siege receivers, lease money receipts, legacy military restriction migration and permissioned lifting.
Reparation, tribute, loan, navy transport/ports, wounded return, doctrine, budget rollover/cancel and archival.
Full clean Core build, new artifacts, final Core plus Supply regression, SQL multiprocess/MySQL and user-deferred Paper/Folia acceptance.
